highlights.title: Grab sticks to the mouse
highlights.description: In the Live Simulation the grabbed point follows the mouse exactly and only stops where the cloth would overstretch. Letting go does not fling the cloth.

highlights.title: No more hanging in the air
highlights.description: Crumpled cloth falls freely again, and garments turning with a body are no longer held back: no frozen points after pulling.

highlights.title: Faster drapes
highlights.description: Static drapes run about twice as fast, and bakes stay calm and free of intersections.

highlights.title: Toolbar over cloth
highlights.description: Toolbar buttons can be clicked even when cloth lies under them during the Live Simulation.
